name: Thai Life Insurance Public Company Limited
summary: Operating within Thailand, Thai Life Insurance Public Company Limited offers a diverse array of life insurance products and services. Its comprehensive portfolio includes coverage for life, retirement planning, investment-linked policies, retail consumers, health, accidents, critical illnesses, and specialized schemes for children and the elderly. The company also provides tailored solutions for savings, tax benefits, and inheritance planning. These services are made available through a wide network of distribution channels, such as commercial and government banking institutions, leasing and hire-purchase firms, consumer finance partnerships, direct marketing initiatives, group employee benefits programs, and digital platforms. Established in 1942, the company maintains its headquarters in Bangkok, Thailand. Thai Life Insurance Public Company Limited (SET:TLI) functions as a subsidiary of V.C. Property Co., Ltd.
